title: AI Data Quality and Master Data Processes

questions.question: Why does master-data quality matter for AI workflows?
options: AI can amplify duplicated, stale, undefined, or ownerless data problems
AI automatically fixes every source record
questions.explanation: AI output quality depends on source-data quality and ownership.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Duplicate records are a common master-data quality signal.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked data-quality readiness plan with controls and rationale
questions.explanation: The artifact maps quality signals to readiness controls.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
When should a data issue become an AI readiness blocker?
options: When ownership, duplicates, stale fields, or definitions are unresolved for a high-impact use case
Only when data is already perfect
Only when no AI use case exists
Never; AI can infer all definitions
questions.explanation: High-impact AI use cases require resolved data-quality controls.

questions.question: What should teams create before scaling AI on operational data?
options: Owners, quality rules, sample checks, and backlog items
questions.explanation: These controls make AI data readiness visible and actionable.
